experiment: P2y frozen shared U-Net ISRJ phase-reset isolation transfer
single_hypothesis: The already-frozen shared swept-component U-Net preserves enough ISRJ phase-reset structure for the P2x zero-trainable-parameter width estimator to generalize across ID and OOD width intervals.

reference_only.P2x_result: exact-component phase-reset estimator passed every preregistered physical-sufficiency gate
reference_only.P2x_raw_boundary: the same estimator on compound raw I/Q failed; component isolation is the unresolved mechanism

fresh_data.generator: matlab/generate_p2w_isrj_width_ood_data.m called with a P2y prefix
fresh_data.split: train only; no test split is generated or opened

variants.C1_raw_phase_reset: P2x estimator on compound raw I/Q
variants.C2_shared_unet_phase_reset: P2x estimator on frozen shared U-Net normalized estimate
variants.C4_time_shuffled_shared_unet: deterministic time shuffle of C2 output

stop_rule: If any physical-sufficiency gate fails, do not attach the shared U-Net width estimate and do not enter a router. The exact P2x oracle permits one separately preregistered dedicated lightweight ISRJ separator on a new identity seed.
next_if_pass: Freeze P2y and evaluate a separately preregistered full 12-parameter predicted-gate attachment on fresh development identities.
